 What Makes an App "Native"?

Only native Mac apps belong on this list: built with macOS frameworks such as SwiftUI and AppKit, using Swift or Objective-C, and designed to feel at home on your Mac.

Electron apps and web wrappers are not eligible. These requirements apply to every listing, including sponsored placements.

---

 ⭐ Spotlight

Sponsored by apps on the MacNative Pro plan. Native apps only.

 
 
 
 SideNotes Native macOS notes that slide out from your screen edge to capture tasks, links, and snippets. 
 
 
 
 Notchlight Live widgets on your Mac's lock screen and a Dynamic Island in the notch for music, calls, and trips. 
 
 
 
 Flow Diagram Flow Diagram turns a messy photo or a quick sketch into a diagram you can edit, share and keep. 
 
 
 
 Fuse Caption Studio Transcribes and translates media into editable captions with a video-editor-style timeline. 
 
 
 
 Strata Files A free, open-source Finder alternative with instant search, folder sizes, and a disk usage map. 
 
 
 
 DMGKit Signs, notarizes, staples, and packages Mac apps into DMG or PKG installers, ready to share. 
 
 
 
 Footages Video organizer for Mac: import camera cards safely and keep every clip across all your drives in one library. 
 
 

---

 🚀 New to Mac? Start Here

Not sure where to begin? These 6 apps are the most universally useful — install them first and thank yourself later.

 
 
 
 Rectangle Snap windows into place with keyboard shortcuts. You'll use this every single day. 
 
 
 
 Maccy Clipboard history that just works. Never lose a copied item again. 
 
 
 
 IINA Plays any video format natively. Makes QuickTime feel like a toy. 
 
 
 
 Mole Uninstall apps properly, clean caches, and reclaim disk space — all in one tool. 
 
 
 
 iTerm2 The terminal macOS should have shipped with. Tabs, split panes, search, and more. 
 
 
 
 TinyCast Supercharged Spotlight replacement. Launch apps, manage clipboard, run scripts, and more — all from one keystroke.
